bpmn:participant.name: BPMN-21 | Owner-Managed Cake Delivery and Handoff

bpmn:process.name: Owner-Managed Cake Delivery and Handoff
bpmn:process.bpmn:documentation: Sources: docs/proposed-bpmn-catalog.md BPMN-21 and all catalog ownership/reuse rules; Chapters/Kitchen406 - Capstone Paper.md SRS 4.16 FR-DEL-16; 4.15 FR-FUL-08,18,20-21,26; supporting FR-FUL-23, FR-CAKE-08-09, NFR-SEC-14, NFR-REL-03,05-06 and BR-20. Website: index.html loads app/owner-orders.js (Confirm handoff for paid ready cakes), app/fulfillment-state.js F.transition (owner-only cake completion), app/earnings-allocation.js and app/owner-cake-state.js. Current XMLs reviewed, particularly BPMN-16/17/18/19/20; SRS governs missing server-side and consistent lock/timestamp persistence in the in-memory prototype. Scope is a ready paid custom-cake operational order linked to the customer-accepted quotation and agreed owner-managed delivery arrangement from BPMN-08. Agreement/quotation revision is not repeated here. Delivery and physical handoff are manual owner activities; system recording is an Owner confirmation, not a Lalamove webhook or customer acknowledgment. Two internal responsibility lanes use sequence flows. No external API pool/message flow or generic broadcast signal is appropriate. Owner access applies to this cake handoff even though other production actions may permit Staff. Authentication is upstream BPMN-30; recheck Owner permission and current state at completion. BPMN-16 is an external reusable call in validation-only mode, with relative import and qualified Process_16 reference, not an embedded subprocess or forced allocation entry. All local checks and essential unsuccessful outcomes are visible. No courier distance limit, Maps eligibility/fee quotation, Lalamove booking/status, live tracking, new payment, refund, production consumption or subscription progress is executed. A failed/cancelled confirmation leaves system state incomplete; actual transport/handoff cannot be undone by system rollback. If physical handoff already occurred, retry only its recording. Completion and lock timestamps, original amounts and shares save consistently; matching concurrent completions reuse the original result. BPMN-28/29 own applicable notices; BPMN-34 owns inquiry; BPMN-43 reporting; BPMN-23 authorized reversal. Existing BPMNs are unchanged. BPMN-20 is partially reviewed by the user, not treated as fully approved.

bpmn:startEvent.name: Ready paid cake enters agreed owner delivery
bpmn:startEvent.bpmn:documentation: Input: custom cake paid and Ready from BPMN-17, with accepted quotation/owner delivery arrangement from BPMN-08 linked through BPMN-13. A fresh recording retry may enter after physical handoff; do not transport or deliver another cake merely because the system save is retried.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Load cake order, accepted quotation and agreed delivery terms
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-DEL-16; FR-CAKE-08-09. Enforce Owner operational record access; read cake identity/products/quantity, accepted quotation version and saved agreed destination/schedule/delivery terms, payment, Ready state, recorded preparation consumption, saved owner allocations and expected/current version. Preserve the agreed arrangement; no new courier fee quotation or silent address change.

bpmn:businessRuleTask.name: Check Owner access, paid Ready cake and accepted arrangement
bpmn:businessRuleTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-DEL-16; FR-FUL-08. Require Owner account, paid confirmed cake operational order, current Ready status, matching accepted quotation and owner-accepted manual delivery arrangement, with prior preparation/material-consumption record. No fixed courier-distance restriction. Reject unsupported order type, unpaid/not-ready state, missing/conflicting agreement or record-access failure. A previously completed matching operation may only reuse its result, not authorize another physical delivery; conflicting completed order requests retain current saved state.

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: Eligible for agreed cake delivery?
bpmn:exclusiveGateway.bpmn:documentation: Eligibility result comes from the preceding task; rejected requests cannot proceed with this workflow. Existing completed matching-operation lookup does not repeat physical delivery. Completion mutation is guarded again at save.

bpmn:callActivity.name: Refer to BPMN-16 — Validate saved preparing-owner allocations
bpmn:callActivity.bpmn:documentation: Invoke k406:Process_16 in validation-only mode with cake fulfillment identity, Owner actor, expected version and action=owner cake handoff. Return saved allocation validation or exact permission/version/owner-split/lock reason. Do not reopen valid saved owner splits or independently save allocation edits. Any supported combined draft must validate and join the same final transaction; preparation shares remain separate from the person driving/confirming.

bpmn:manualTask.name: Transport cake under the accepted owner-managed arrangement
bpmn:manualTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-DEL-16; BR-20. Owner manually transports the prepared cake according to accepted quotation delivery terms. This is physical work outside API integration, with no Lalamove booking, fixed service-area distance cap or automated location tracking. If already handed over and retrying a recording, review the established fact instead of repeating transport.

bpmn:userTask.name: Confirm actual cake handoff in system, or leave incomplete
bpmn:userTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-FUL-21. Owner confirms actual cake handoff only after it has occurred. An incomplete or unconfirmed physical handoff must take the No path and leave completion unrecorded. Customer receipt acknowledgment is not required. Cancelling confirmation creates no status/lock/time change and does not cancel/refund the paid cake. A recording retry must not repeat transport or handoff.

bpmn:endEvent.name: No completion recorded; handoff still needs confirmation
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: Output: no completion saved by this attempt. Retain the current paid/Ready saved operational state unless independently changed; the physical delivery may be pending, or the Owner may still need to record an already performed handoff. No automatic reschedule, cancellation, refund or repeat delivery is invented.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Recheck handoff controls; save Completed, time and allocation lock together
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-FUL-08,20-21,23,26; NFR-SEC-14; NFR-REL-03,05-06. Under consistent/version-checked update revalidate Owner permission, actual handoff confirmation, paid Ready cake state, accepted order/arrangement identity, recorded consumption and valid saved allocations/action locks. Save Completed status, completion timestamp, allocation lock and lock timestamp, action/actor history and updated version together. Preserve original cake product amounts, payment/quotation links and owner percentages; driver/acting account receives no automatic share. Any supported combined owner draft/history joins the transaction. First check current operation/completion identity: if this same handoff completed concurrently after earlier checks, reuse original saved completion/time without new mutation. New save commits all related records or none. Stale/conflicting or failed write retains latest saved records/evidence for safe recording retry, not physical redelivery. No second stock consumption, payment or report calculation.

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: Completion save result?
bpmn:exclusiveGateway.bpmn:documentation: Three mutually exclusive results are visible: new completion saved; same handoff already recorded concurrently, so reuse its result; or failed/conflicting request. Do not loop back or restamp original completion. Earlier eligibility checks do not prevent a concurrent matching completion, so the protected save rechecks identity.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Use recorded cake completion for applicable notification follow-up
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Use this same recorded completion identity for supported BPMN-28 external or BPMN-29 internal notification work, independently of successful completion. No generic broadcast-signal architecture is prescribed, and no customer receipt action or notification-delivery success is required. Matching completion reuse resumes only pending follow-up and never duplicates already handled effects. Cake orders do not call BPMN-05 subscription progress. Status inquiry is BPMN-34; report generation is BPMN-43.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Cake handoff completed; time recorded and allocations locked
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: Output: paid cake fulfillment Completed with recorded handoff completion time, preserved original product amounts and locked allocations. Repeated requests cannot duplicate completion/sales or change its original timestamp. BPMN-43 uses actual completion date separately; BPMN-23 owns authorized accidental reversal. No general edit/unlock or automatic inventory reversal is introduced.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Explain Owner, payment, status or accepted-arrangement issue
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Return exact Owner/type/payment/Ready/quotation-arrangement/material-record reason. This attempt makes no saved operational change. Agreement changes belong to the appropriate quotation review process, not silent conversion to courier or pickup.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Cake delivery blocked; review saved details

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Return permission, stale-version, allocation or lock reason
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Return BPMN-16 reason. Permission failure requires allowed Owner action; stale version requires refresh/review; missing/invalid shares may be corrected separately via BPMN-16 while editable. Keep latest saved state; no external delivery API request or customer acknowledgment bypass.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Handoff action blocked; review before retry

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Explain save/conflict failure; preserve latest saved records
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Save failure or conflicting operation creates no partial completion, timestamp, lock or allocation change. Retain current independently committed state and log diagnosis. If physical handoff occurred, recover the record only; do not deliver another cake. A matching saved completion takes the explicit reuse branch, not this failure path.

bpmn:textAnnotation.bpmn:text: Cake delivery eligibility Owner account; paid Ready cake. Accepted quotation linked to the order. Use the agreed manual delivery arrangement. Preparation/consumption already recorded. No fixed courier-distance limit; no Lalamove, Maps quotation or pickup workflow.

Refer to BPMN-16 Validate existing allocations, Owner action permission, version and locks. No forced owner-split entry. Driving/confirming does not earn an automatic owner share. Any supported combined allocation draft joins the same completion save.

Handoff completion controls Owner confirms actual physical handoff. No customer acknowledgment required. Completed, completion time and allocation lock/time save together. Recheck controls and duplicate identity at save. New save, matching-result reuse and failure are separate outcomes. No second ingredient consumption.

After cake completion Applicable notices: BPMN-28/29, independently of successful completion. Status inquiry: BPMN-34. Reporting: BPMN-43 uses actual completion date and original amounts. No subscription progress or new payment. Any recording retry must not repeat physical delivery or handoff.

bpmn:manualTask.name: Carry out actual cake handoff under the agreed terms
bpmn:manualTask.bpmn:documentation: Physical cake handoff by the owner. If handoff cannot be completed, do not confirm Completed; retain incomplete state and arrange next steps outside any invented automatic recovery policy. On system-only retry, verify the already completed handoff rather than perform it again.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Reuse recorded handoff identity and original completion time
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: A matching cake handoff completed concurrently after the earlier checks. Reuse its saved result/timestamp, owner shares and lock without a new completion or sale. Follow-up reuses that same identity and performs only still-pending applicable work.
